essence: The supplicant seeks both personal support and ritual purification of the seat from the goddess.
Refuge is taken in the three-eyed goddess of speech who bears bright radiance.
The salutation honors an eternal, thousand-named person who sustains vast cosmic ages.
The invoked rivers are asked to make their presence manifest in the water at hand.
